changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'MarkitLineageData' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'ParentID' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='fusion') BEGIN alter table [fusion].[MarkitLineageData] drop column ParentID; END IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'MarkitLineageData' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'UltimateParentID' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='fusion') BEGIN alter table [fusion].[MarkitLineageData] drop column UltimateParentID; END IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'MarkitLineageData' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Level' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='fusion') BEGIN alter table [fusion].[MarkitLineageData] drop column [Level]; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'MarkitLineageData' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'ParentID' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='fusion') BEGIN alter table [fusion].[MarkitLineageData] add ParentID int null; END IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'MarkitLineageData' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'UltimateParentID' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='fusion') BEGIN alter table [fusion].[MarkitLineageData] add UltimateParentID int null; END IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'MarkitLineageData' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Level' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='fusion') BEGIN alter table [fusion].[MarkitLineageData] add [Level] int null; END
